description: The fatal close on a run that read nothing at all. The dataset is opened, holds no record, and the first READ reports '10' so END-OF-FILE becomes 'Y' immediately; the CLOSE then reports '96', whose first byte is '9', so the extended branch renders the second byte as its decimal value - '6' is 54 - giving FILE STATUS IS: NNNN9054. Four lines and nothing else: the opening banner, the close's error text, the rendered status and the abend banner. It is the exact complement of case02, which is the same empty dataset with a close that succeeds, and the pair isolates the close's two arms with every other variable held fixed.

expectedMessages.text: START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBCUS01C
